justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing incised linear work with a band of repeated small marks running horizontally near the top and framing lines along the edges, which is about as generic as correspondences get. A shows only abstract angular script-like strokes and an arc with no figures at all, while B shows a crowded zoomorphic scene of quadrupeds, birds and a snake-like creature in profile with modelled relief bodies, so the actual subject matter has nothing in common.
